headline: Referred Comcast's request to install underground conduit and a manhole at 65 Riverside Ave to the next meeting.
summary: The petition also asks to place a 3'3' manhole over an existing Comcast conduit on E Transit Way. Comcast and three city officials spoke on the petition before the vote. Any conditions the City Engineer requests will be added to the next meeting's agenda.
decisions: Referred Comcast's petition for a grant of location at 65 Riverside Ave to the next regular meeting, 7-0.

decision_titles: Comcast petition for underground conduit at 65 Riverside Ave
plain_text:
1 
 
 
Medford City Council 
Medford, Massachusetts 
  
Special Meeting, October 21 2026 
 
This meeting took place via Zoom. 
 
CALL TO ORDER 
 
President Zac Bears called the Special Meeting of the Medford City Council to via Zoom. 
 
ROLL CALL 
 
Present: President Bears; Vice President Lazzaro; Councilor Callahan; Councilor Leming; 
Councilor Mullane; Councilor Scarpelli. Six members were present and One member was 
absent (Councilor Tseng). Councilor Tseng later joined the meeting. Also present: City Clerk 
Laurel Siegel. 
 
PETITIONS, PRESENTATIONS AND SIMILAR PAPERS 
 
26-185 – Petition for Grant of Location – Comcast – 65 Riverside Ave
2 
 
 
Addressing the Council: 
Dave Flewelling, Comcast 
Owen Wartella, City Engineer 
William Forte, Building Commissioner 
Tim McGivern, Commissioner of Public Works 
 
Motion made by Vice President Lazzaro to refer the matter to the next Regular Meeting of the 
City Council on October 27, 2026, seconded by Councilor Scarpelli. Approved on a Roll Call 
Vote of Seven in favor, Zero opposed. 
 
 
ADJOURNMENT 
 
Motion to adjourn made by Councilor Callahan, seconded by Councilor Mullane. Approved on a 
Roll Call Vote of Seven in Favor, Zero opposed. 
 
President Bears adjourned the meeting. 
 
A true copy, Attest. 
 
Laurel Siegel 
City Clerk
